text.en: Dog owners frequently praise Kieran for his calm, patient manner and attentive approach during appointments. Several clients note that he takes plenty of time with each pet so they never feel rushed. Reviewers consistently express full confidence in leaving their pets in his capable care.

Pet owners highlight how well Kieran handles nervous or anxious dogs, ensuring they remain settled throughout the session. Multiple reviews mention dogs appearing completely relaxed upon arrival and leaving happily afterwards. Clients feel relieved finding a groomer who eases their pets' stress.

Clients describe the grooming results as top tier, highlighting that their dogs look neat and well maintained after their visits. Owners of breeds requiring thorough coats, such as Golden Retrievers, report complete satisfaction with the styling. Regular patrons return repeatedly for the dependable results.

q.en: How do nervous or anxious dogs handle appointments here?

a.en: Reviewers note that Kieran takes extra time and patience with nervous pets, helping them feel settled and relaxed throughout grooming.

q.en: Can larger dog breeds be groomed at the salon?

a.en: Yes, clients mention booking complete grooming sessions for larger breeds, including Golden Retrievers, with very satisfying results.

q.en: How do clients rate the pricing and value of services?

a.en: Pet owners describe the grooming services as great value for money and praise the high quality delivered.

q.en: Do pets feel comfortable returning for repeat visits?

a.en: Yes, reviewers report that dogs arrive relaxed and happy on repeat appointments, showing strong trust in the groomer.
